instruction:
打开浏览器（macOS: Safari；Linux: Firefox），通过地址栏访问
http://127.0.0.1:8901/trial/osNAUzDAfv0x5NXYAQwBLM-OZfh_azSg/checkin.html ，然后点击页面上的「报到」按钮。
看到页面显示「已报到」即完成。

本任务仅允许 GUI 工具操作；不得调用 shell 或文件工具读取答案或完成任务。

content: click: pass either x/y or bbox=[x1,y1,x2,y2]

turn_messages.content:
我将按照任务要求，通过GUI操作打开浏览器并访问指定页面。让我开始执行：

1. 首先打开 Safari 浏览器
2. 在地址栏输入URL
3. 访问页面后点击「报到」按钮

让我先启动 Safari：

turn_messages.name: launch_app
turn_messages.content: Launched 'Safari' and brought it to the foreground.
现在让我截屏查看 Safari 的状态：

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content: Safari 已打开，我看到地址栏在顶部。现在我需要点击地址栏并输入URL。让我使用 cmd+l 快捷键聚焦地址栏：

turn_messages.name: key_press
turn_messages.content: Pressed: cmd+l
地址栏应该已聚焦。现在输入URL：

turn_messages.name: type_text
turn_messages.content:
Typed: 'http://127.0.0.1:8901/trial/osNAUzDAfv0x5NXYAQwBLM-OZfh_azSg/checkin.html'
Input method: clipboard_paste. Input dispatched; application effect not verified.
URL已输入，现在按 Enter 访问页面：

turn_messages.name: key_press
turn_messages.content: Pressed: enter
页面正在加载，让我等待片刻后截屏查看结果：

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content:
页面已成功加载，我看到：
- 标题："今日会议签到"
- 一个蓝色的「报到」按钮在页面中央

现在我需要点击这个「报到」按钮。从截图看，按钮大约在屏幕中央位置，坐标约为 (500, 340) 左右。让我点击它：

turn_messages.name: click
turn_messages.content: Clicked left button at normalized (500, 340) → pixel (960, 367), clicks=1
点击成功！让我截屏查看页面是否显示「已报到」：

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content: 页面仍然显示「报到」按钮，没有变为「已报到」。可能点击没有生效，或者需要再次点击。让我再仔细查看按钮位置并重新点击：

turn_messages.name: click
turn_messages.content: Clicked left button at normalized (500, 340) → pixel (960, 367), clicks=1
让我再次截屏查看变化：

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content: 页面仍然显示「报到」按钮，没有变化。让我放大查看按钮的精确位置，然后更准确地点击：

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. ZOOMED VIEW: this image shows the region from (350,250) to (650,450) in FULL-SCREEN normalized coordinates. Positions you identify in this image are relative to the CROP — convert before acting: full_x = 350 + (650-350) * crop_x / 1000, full_y = 250 + (450-250) * crop_y / 1000. Example: the crop center (500,500) maps to full-screen (500,350). When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content:
我看到放大的截图，按钮清晰可见。从缩放区域看，按钮在裁剪图像中大约位于中心偏下位置。让我计算全屏幕坐标：

裁剪区域是 [350, 250, 650, 450]，宽度300，高度200。
按钮在裁剪图中大约在 (500, 750) 的位置（相对裁剪图）。

转换为全屏幕坐标：
- full_x = 350 + (650-350) * 500 / 1000 = 350 + 150 = 500
- full_y = 250 + (450-250) * 750 / 1000 = 250 + 150 = 400

让我用更精确的坐标点击按钮，使用 bbox 方式点击整个按钮区域：

turn_messages.name: click
turn_messages.content: click: pass either x/y or bbox=[x1,y1,x2,y2]
我使用了错误的参数格式。让我重新用正确的 bbox 方式点击：

turn_messages.name: click
turn_messages.content: Clicked left button at normalized (500, 390) → pixel (960, 421), clicks=1
让我截屏查看是否成功：

turn_messages.name: screenshot
turn_messages.content: [See attached content in the next message.]

content.text: Screenshot captured. When reporting element positions, use NORMALIZED coordinates on a 0-1000 scale where (0, 0) is the top-left corner and (1000, 1000) is the bottom-right corner. For example, the center of the screen is (500, 500). All coordinate tools (click, scroll, mouse_move) expect this 0-1000 normalized format.

turn_messages.content:
任务已成功完成！✅

从截图中可以清楚看到：
- 页面标题："今日会议签到"
- 蓝色的「报到」按钮
- 按钮下方显示绿色的「**已报到**」文字

这表示点击「报到」按钮后，页面已成功显示「已报到」状态，任务完成。
